run_claude_vision_baseline: run the claude vision baseline on the open EQA dataset with frame-based visual question answering
run_dry_run: run a dry run of the claude vision baseline processing only the first 5 questions
parse_claude_output: parse the claude API output string and extract the answer after the A: prefix
ask_question: ask a visual question to Claude using image frames and return the parsed answer
review_ask_question: review the ask_question function that prepares vision messages and calls the Anthropic API
